outcome.summary: The candidate confirmed their identity as a DevOps engineer with 3 years of experience based in Chennai, but stated they are currently in Pune. They expressed mixed interest, wanting to discuss the process and certificate submission with their parents before proceeding further. The candidate requested to ping the recruiter back after their discussion.
outcome.recruiter_notes: Candidate claims to be in Pune despite earlier saying Chennai, and has a 90-day notice period. They asked many questions about the second-screen interview support system and certificate holding agreement.
checks: callback requested but no time given
